_note: Editable reconciliation config. Edit the holidays list whenever needed, then re-run: node scripts/recon-refresh.js. Anyone who worked a SCHEDULED shift on one of these dates gets the whole shift credited as HOLIDAY OT, the row is labelled 'Official Holiday', and an ANNUAL-LEAVE (L) day on a holiday is counted as the holiday (returns to the leave balance, not deducted). A cross-midnight shift is owned by its START day, so a holiday/OFF day never re-grabs the previous night's session.
